market.question: Will the highest temperature in Karachi be 35°C on May 8?

assessment.reasoning: Karachi May highs typically 34-42°C; recent news 'mercury rose to 42°C in Karachi May 4 with hotter weather forecast'. Bucket 35°C (range likely 35.0-35.9°C) is on the cool end of typical May. With recent heat wave, unlikely to land specifically in 35°C bucket.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Conflicting forecast sources (one site showed 29°C, news shows 42°C); Masroor airbase station readings may differ from city.
